observed_reason: No identity-based policy allows iam:GetRole; no explicit deny, boundary or SCP conclusion is proven.
authority_scope: Standing ChangeBridge-only delegation covers preparation and bounded access resolution; execution requires an actual qualified administrator connection and reviewed exact policy digest.

phase2.rule: First collect attached-policy and permissions-boundary ARNs using Phase 1 access. Review any required Phase 2 grant against those exact observed ARNs; do not infer or pregrant them.

exact role ARN and RoleId before and after
unchanged trust-policy digest before and after
prior inline-policy absence or exact-equivalent document
actual inline-policy readback and canonical document SHA256
rerun main observer result with exact GitHub head and run identity
private exact policy-byte snapshot used for validation and write
independently reviewed preflight RoleId and trust digest supplied to apply
